job: Software quality assurance intern. Students of any major and any academic year are eligible; no degree-field or graduation-date restriction. Write Python tests for input validation, reproduce defects, review fixes in Git, and communicate results. Coursework, personal projects, and volunteering qualify; prior paid experience is not required.
resume:
EDUCATION
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, second-year student.

PROJECTS
Built a test harness for a volunteer club's reservation form. Wrote Python tests covering empty fields, invalid dates, and repeated submissions. Isolated a validation bug, documented reproduction steps, and checked the fix.
EXPERIENCE
During a six-week project, reviewed changes in Git, discussed test results with a teammate, and maintained a concise defect log.
SKILLS
Python, automated tests, Git, debugging, and clear issue reports.

job: Community exhibit communications intern. Any major and any academic year are eligible. Draft accessible exhibit captions, verify facts, create clear handouts, and explain them to visitors. Volunteer and class projects count as experience. No specific degree, graduation date, or paid-work history is required.
resume:
EDUCATION
Bachelor's degree in Art History, second-year student.

PROJECTS
Developed an illustrated handout explaining a neighborhood photography exhibit. Drafted short captions, checked factual claims against source notes, and revised confusing wording after visitor feedback.
EXPERIENCE
Supported three volunteer exhibit sessions by explaining the handout, answering visitor questions, and recording recurring questions.
SKILLS
Plain-language writing, copy editing, accessible page layout, source checking, and welcoming public presentations.

job: Laboratory data operations intern. Open to students of all majors and all academic years. Reconcile sample identifiers, check duplicates, create basic R plots, and document discrepancies. This role handles records and does not perform clinical care or require licensure. Supervised coursework is sufficient; no degree-field or graduation-date requirement.
resume:
EDUCATION
Bachelor's degree in Biology, second-year student.

PROJECTS
Organized a teaching laboratory's enzyme assay records. Matched sample identifiers across worksheets, flagged duplicate identifiers, and plotted replicate measurements in R. Kept flagged observations in an exception log instead of silently deleting them.
EXPERIENCE
Completed a supervised data-cleaning assignment and explained discrepancies to the laboratory coordinator using a reproducible script.
SKILLS
R, CSV data cleaning, identifier reconciliation, basic plots, and documentation of data-quality limitations.

job: Finance operations intern. Students from any major and academic year are eligible; no graduation-date or accounting-degree restriction. Use Excel to match invoices to purchase records, detect duplicates, summarize outstanding items, and request missing documents. Class or volunteer projects are acceptable; no license or paid experience is required.
resume:
EDUCATION
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, second-year student.

PROJECTS
Created an Excel workbook for a student group's supplier invoices. Used lookup formulas to match invoices with purchase records, flagged duplicate invoice numbers, and summarized unpaid items in a pivot table.
EXPERIENCE
Reconciled one term of records with a volunteer treasurer, documented exceptions, and drafted polite requests for missing receipts.
SKILLS
Excel lookups, pivot tables, reconciliation, accurate recordkeeping, and concise written follow-up.
